tooltip: Opens in the AI assistant panel (⌘I). Platform checks need no setup; the AI analysis needs an AI service configured in Settings.
title: AI Assistant
stopped: Stopped. What arrived so far and the platform checks above are kept.
configureFirst: Configure an AI service in Settings to get an AI explanation. The platform checks above work without one.

finding.none: No known failure pattern matched; the AI analysis below reads the logs.
finding.verifyNote: Rule matches are hypotheses: the AI analysis checks them against the logs and says whether they hold.

kv_cache_insufficient.title: KV cache does not fit
kv_cache_insufficient.fix: Lower --max-model-len, raise the GPU memory utilization, or use a larger tensor-parallel size.

cuda_oom.title: Out of GPU memory
cuda_oom.fix: Check that the weights fit each GPU's share, that no other process holds memory on the GPU, and lower --max-model-len or raise the tensor-parallel size.

shm_insufficient.title: Shared memory (/dev/shm) too small
shm_insufficient.fix: Give the container a larger shared memory size (or ipc=host).

nccl_failure.title: Collective communication failed (NCCL/HCCL)
nccl_failure.fix: Check the network interface the collective library uses, P2P support, firewalls between nodes, and that every rank started.

disk_full.title: Disk full
disk_full.fix: Free space on the node's model storage or container runtime directory.

port_in_use.title: Port already in use
port_in_use.fix: Another process or container on the node holds the serving port; stop it or use another port.

image_pull_denied.title: Image pull failed
image_pull_denied.fix: Check the image name and tag, and the registry credentials on the node.

dtype_unsupported.title: GPU does not support this dtype
dtype_unsupported.fix: Serve with --dtype float16, or use a GPU that supports the dtype.

gpu_arch_unsupported.title: Image not built for this GPU architecture
gpu_arch_unsupported.fix: Use an image built for this GPU's compute capability, or another GPU.

trust_remote_code_required.title: Model needs --trust-remote-code
trust_remote_code_required.fix: Enable it only if you trust the model repository's code.

model_arch_unsupported.title: Engine does not support this model architecture
model_arch_unsupported.fix: Use a newer engine image or another engine.

model_files_missing.title: Model files missing or wrong path
model_files_missing.fix: Check the model path in the launch command and whether the download completed.

hf_download_failed.title: Model hub download failed
hf_download_failed.fix: Check the repository id, the access token for gated models, and the node's network or proxy.

fit.title: Fit on the online fleet
fit.noNodes: No online node has an accelerator to size this model against.
fit.note: Weights plus the engine reserve at {{util}}% memory utilization; multi-node serving and quantized variants are not considered.
